author: Davidgo5867

english.text: After 10 o'clock in the morning of the 22nd of February of 2022, on Lulu Island, I was eating pizza and drinking iced tea at the pizzeria. Then, I was at the cafe drinking my usual black iced tea. Heading home, near the clinic, I saw a very handsome Iranian man talking to another. I have seen him several times in that village. I thought that he was an Arab, but he was speaking Farsi, the language of Iran, today.

jyutping: 2022 nin4 2 jyut6 22 hou6 ziu1 zou2 sap6 dim2 gei2，hai2 lou6 lou6 dou2，ngo5 hai2 bok6 beng2 pou2 sik6 gan2 bok6 beng2 tung4 jam2 gan2 bing1 caa4。jin4 hau6，ngo5 hai2 gaa3 fe1 gun2 jam2 gan2 ngo5 ping4 si4 jam2 gan2 ge3 hak1 bing1 caa4。faan1 uk1 kei2，hai2 can2 so2 fu6 gan6，ngo5 gin3 dou2 jat1 go3 hou2 leng3 zai2 ge3 ji1 long5 naam4 jan2 tung4 ling6 jat1 go3 jan4 king1 gan2 gai3，ngo5 hai2 go2 tiu4 cyun1 gin3 gwo3 keoi5 gei2 ci3，ngo5 ji5 wai4 keoi5 hai6 aa3 laai1 baak3 jan4，daan6 hai6 keoi5 gam1 jat6 gong2 gan2 bo1 si1 jyu5，zik1 hai6 ji1 long5 ge3 jyu5 jin4。
text: 2022年2月22號朝早十點幾，喺露露島，我喺薄餅舖食緊薄餅同飲緊冰茶。然後，我喺咖啡館飲緊我平時飲緊嘅黑冰茶。返屋企，喺診所附近，我見到一個好靚仔嘅伊朗男人同另一個人傾緊計，我喺嗰條村見過佢幾次，我以為佢係阿拉伯人，但係佢今日講緊波斯語，即係伊朗嘅語言。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Today on the 12th of January of 2022, at the cafe, I had a glass of black iced tea. Upon exiting, I greeted Hans the Netherlander on a wheelchair a happy new year. We briefly discussed about the ongoing deployment of the James Webb Space Telescope to the Sun-Earth L2 Langrange point. The worry at the moment is about micrometeorites. Incidentally, Hans mentioned a Scottish friend Tom who took a lethal injection yesterday at his hospice because he had cancer.

jyutping: gam1 jat6 2022 nin4 1 jyut6 12 hou6，hai2 gaa3 fe1 gun2，ngo5 jam2 zo2 bui1 hak1 bing1 caa4。 lei4 hoi1 go2 zan6，ngo5 hai2 leon4 ji2 soeng6 tung4 ho4 laan1 jan4 hon3 si1 daa2 ziu1 fu1，zuk1 keoi5 san1 nin4 faai3 lok6。 ngo5 dei6 gaan2 daan1 gam2 tou2 leon6 zo2 jau5 gwaan1 zim1 si6 wai5 baak3 taai3 hung1 mong6 jyun5 geng3 ge3 ci4 zuk6 bou6 cyu5 heoi3 taai3 joeng4 - dei6 kau4 L2 long5 long5 jat6 dim2 ge3 si6。 ji4 gaa1 daam1 sam1 ge3 hai6 gwaan1 jyu1 mei4 wan5 sek6。 seon6 daai3 jat1 tai4，hon3 si1 tai4 dou3 jau5 go3 sou1 gaak3 laan4 pang4 jau5 tong1 mou5，keoi5 kam4 jat6 jan1 wai6 waan6 zo2 ngaam4 zing3 ji4 hai2 keoi5 ge3 lam4 zung1 gwaan1 waai4 zung1 sam1 daa2 zo2 zi3 ming6 zam1。
text: 今日2022年1月12號，喺咖啡館，我飲咗杯黑冰茶。 離開嗰陣，我喺輪椅上同荷蘭人漢斯打招呼，祝佢新年快樂。 我哋簡單噉討論咗有關占士韋伯太空望遠鏡嘅持續部署去太陽 - 地球 L2朗朗日點嘅事。 而家擔心嘅係關於微隕石。 順帶一提，漢斯提到有個蘇格蘭朋友湯姆，佢琴日因為患咗癌症而喺佢嘅臨終關懷中心打咗致命針。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: I can’t stand the word 'empathy', actually. I think 'empathy' is a made-up, new-age term, and it does a lot of damage. I much prefer the word 'compassion', and I much prefer the word 'sympathy'. Empathy is where you try to feel someone’s pain and sorrows as if they’re your own. Compassion allows for understanding. I prefer the word 'sympathy', because politics has weaponized empathy.

jyutping: lou5 sat6 gong2，ngo5 zan1 hai6 sau6 m4 zyu6「empathy」ni1 go3 zi6。ngo5 gok3 dak1「empathy」hai6 jat1 go3 jan4 wai4 zai3 zou6 ceot1 lai4 ge3 san1 si4 doi6 seot6 jyu5，daai3 lai4 hou2 do1 waai6 cyu3。ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 jung6「compassion」tung4「sympathy」ne1 loeng5 go3 zi6。Empathy hai6 si3 tou4 zoeng1 jan4 dei6 ge3 tung3 fu2 tung4 bei1 soeng1 dong3 sing4 zi6 gei2 ge3 lai4 gam2 sau6；compassion zau6 jung4 heoi2 lei5 gaai2。ngo5 gang3 pin1 hou2「sympathy」，jan1 wai4 zing3 zi6 ji5 ging1 zoeng1 empathy mou5 hei3 faa3 zo2。
text: 老實講，我真係受唔住「empathy」呢個字。我覺得「empathy」係一個人為製造出嚟嘅新時代術語，帶嚟好多壞處。我好鍾意用「compassion」同「sympathy」呢兩個字。Empathy 係試圖將人哋嘅痛苦同悲傷當成自己嘅嚟感受；compassion 就容許理解。我更偏好「sympathy」，因為政治已經將 empathy 武器化咗。
